body:
Adds `research/flex-twin`: a rigid-body twin says PD loop is stable at every bandwidth; the real two-mass plant with load-side sensing is unstable above eps_c ≈ δ/ζ (exact cubic, independent of mass ratio). Collocated sensing stable on all 7,320 grid points; step-response validation misses the problem; certified bandwidth inherits modal-damping error one-for-one.

- 9 unit tests pass; `experiments/run.py` output committed in `results.txt`
- README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added; `python site/build.py` prints ok
- Stylised, simulated "real" plant, no hardware data (stated in README/paper)
